incompatible_pairs.reason: Incompatible bibliography drivers (BibTeX-based natbib vs Biber-based biblatex). Loading both triggers command/counter redefinition errors.
incompatible_pairs.resolution: Keep biblatex (with biber) if modern \addbibresource/\printbibliography is used; keep natbib (with bibtex) if publisher template requires .bst.

incompatible_pairs.reason: Obsolete subfigure clashes directly with subcaption (Command \c@subfigure already defined).
incompatible_pairs.resolution: Remove subfigure and use subcaption (\begin{subfigure}) or \subfloat with caption=false when using IEEEtran.

incompatible_pairs.reason: Both define subfigure/subtable float interfaces and conflict unconditionally.
incompatible_pairs.resolution: Prefer subcaption with \usepackage{caption,subcaption}; only keep subfig if mandated by legacy template.

incompatible_pairs.reason: Both redefine \cite handling and cause incompatible spacing/sorting behavior.
incompatible_pairs.resolution: Remove cite when using natbib (pass [sort&compress] to natbib) or biblatex.

incompatible_pairs.reason: cite package is incompatible with biblatex.
incompatible_pairs.resolution: Remove \usepackage{cite} and pass sorting/compression options to biblatex.

incompatible_pairs.reason: inputenc is for 8-bit pdflatex; fontspec/xeCJK/ctex require UTF-8 native XeLaTeX/LuaLaTeX.
incompatible_pairs.resolution: Drop inputenc/fontenc when compiling with xelatex/lualatex, or guard with \usepackage{iftex} / \ifPDFTeX.

incompatible_pairs.reason: txfonts loaded before amsmath causes \iint/\iiint already defined errors.
incompatible_pairs.resolution: Replace obsolete txfonts/pxfonts with newtxtext + newtxmath (loaded AFTER amsmath).

incompatible_pairs.reason: Both redefine underline/strikeout hooks and can interfere without [normalem] on ulem.
incompatible_pairs.resolution: Always pass \usepackage[normalem]{ulem} so \emph stays italic rather than underlined.

incompatible_pairs.reason: epsfig is a legacy wrapper superseded by graphicx.

load_order_rules.reason: amsthm checks amsmath definitions to integrate \qedhere cleanly.
newtxmath adapts math symbols to amsmath when loaded afterward.
Load xcolor with options (table,dvipsnames) before tikz/hyperref to avoid option clashes.
Pass xcolor options before packages that internally load xcolor.
hyperref patches equation/align anchors and should follow amsmath.
cleveref MUST be loaded after hyperref (one of the very few exceptions to hyperref-last).
glossaries requires hyperref loaded before it to create clickable glossary links.
Load algorithm before hyperref (and algorithmic/algpseudocode after or per hyperref docs) to prevent \theHalgorithm anchor warnings.

deprecated_or_antipattern_macros.reason: Inconsistent spacing around '=' and broken equation numbering/labels.
Masking wide-table overflow with \resizebox distorts font size unevenly and violates publisher readability.
deprecated_or_antipattern_macros.replacement: Use tabularx (X columns), p{width}, \small/\footnotesize, \setlength{\tabcolsep}{...}, or sideways/longtable.

deprecated_or_antipattern_macros.reason: Plain TeX font switches ({\bf ...}) are deprecated in LaTeX2e and fail in some classes (e.g., KOMA-Script).
Plain TeX $$...$$ causes vertical spacing bugs and breaks amsmath fleqn/leqno.
deprecated_or_antipattern_macros.replacement: Use \[ ... \] for unnumbered display equations or \begin{equation} for numbered equations.
